title: Hardware-Friendly Token-Group Activation Quantization for Low-Bit Mamba Super-Resolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.16261v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mamba-based super-resolution models are efficient alternatives to Transformer-based restoration backbones, but their low-bit post-training quantization remains challenging because selective scan, Mamba's input-dependent state-space operator, induces different activation ranges across spatial tokens. Thus, a single layer-wise clipping range poorly matches all tokens. We propose Token-Group Quantization, a hardware-friendly activation PTQ framework that statically approximates a hardware-unfriendly post-scan grouping oracle, where tokens with similar preferred clipping ranges are assigned to the same group. To avoid runtime post-scan grouping in static low-bit inference, a lightweight predictor infers the groups from pre-scan features available before the quantized scan path. translated_title: 面向硬件友好的令牌分组激活量化用于低比特Mamba超分辨率
translated_abstract: 基于Mamba的超分辨率模型是Transformer类图像修复骨干网络的高效替代方案，但其低比特训练后量化（PTQ）仍然具有挑战性，因为选择性扫描——Mamba中依赖于输入的状态空间算子——会在不同空间令牌之间产生不同的激活范围。因此，单一的逐层裁剪范围难以匹配所有令牌。我们提出令牌分组量化，这是一个硬件友好的激活PTQ框架，它以静态方式近似一个硬件不友好的扫描后分组“神谕”，即将具有相似首选裁剪范围的令牌分配到同一组。为了避免在静态低比特推理时进行运行时的扫描后分组，一个轻量级预测器从量化扫描路径之前可获得的扫描前特征推断出分组。在校准过程中，我们通过对捕获相似舍入-裁剪行为的扫描后激活描述符进行聚类来形成伪标签。在推理时，冻结的预测器…
tldr: 提出了一种硬件友好的令牌分组激活量化框架（Token-Group Quantization），利用轻量级预测器从扫描前特征静态预测令牌分组，解决了Mamba超分辨率模型低比特量化中不同令牌激活范围差异大的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes a hardware-friendly Token-Group Quantization framework that uses a lightweight predictor to statically infer token groups from pre-scan features, addressing the challenge of varying activation ranges across spatial tokens in low-bit quantization of Mamba-based super-resolution models.
